title: CSV vs Parquet vs Avro
interviewAnswer: CSV is simple text but lacks strong types/efficient analytics; Parquet is columnar for analytical scans; Avro is row-oriented with schemas and is common for event serialization.
why: CSV vs Parquet vs Avro is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
deepDive: CSV is simple text but lacks strong types/efficient analytics; Parquet is columnar for analytical scans; Avro is row-oriented with schemas and is common for event serialization. Schema evolution differs. Compression and predicate pushdown matter. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: Use Avro for Kafka events and Parquet for analytical history in object storage.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
